text.p: Ergobank will hold an extraordinary shareholders meeting on November 19 to present plans for a rights and bonus issue, it said on Wednesday.
Shareholders will decide on the price of the new shares and the rights exercise period. The rights will entitle shareholders to three new shares for every 20 existing, it said.

Ergobank will also proceed with a bonus share issue resulting from a partial capitalisation of reserves -- issuing two new bonus shares for every 10 outstanding after the rights issue, it said in a statement.
For example, a shareholder of 200 shares will be entitled to subscribe to the rights issue and buy 30 new shares at a price agreed by the shareholders meeting, ending up with 230 shares.
Soon after, the shareholder will get 46 bonus shares, ending up with 276 shares.
Ergobank's board of directors will also propose the issuance of 162,000 shares which will be distributed exclusively to bank personnel at the same price as the rights issue.

Ergobank will thus end up with 25.2 million outstanding shares of a par value of 1,500 drachmas and equity capital exceeding 90 billion drachmas. The capital increase will help it implement a strategy that aims to further increase its market share. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
